articles.abstract_en: In many economic settings, matching takes place under imperfect information about agents’ characteristics that are payoff-relevant to the match. This paper develops a matching model in which agents’ payoff-relevant characteristics are realized after matching takes place, and matching is based on the agents’ observable ex-ante characteristics, which stochastically determine the payoff-relevant ones. We derive conditions for positive and negative sorting. The conditions differ depending on whether agents’ characteristics are stochastically larger or more variable as a function of the agents’ ex-ante attributes. We apply our framework to risk sharing and household income inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多经济环境中，匹配发生在对代理人特征信息不完全的情况下，而这些特征对匹配的收益相关。本文开发了一个匹配模型，其中代理人的收益相关特征在匹配发生后实现，匹配基于代理人可观察的事前特征，这些特征随机决定收益相关特征。我们推导了正排序和负排序的条件。这些条件根据代理人的特征是否作为其事前属性的函数随机更大或更可变而有所不同。我们将我们的框架应用于风险分担和家庭收入不平等。

articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether ambiguity afflicting the long-run rate of growth fades away in a nonexchangeable environment (time-varying instantaneous expected growth rate). Two types of ambiguity are considered: static (multiple priors) and dynamic (multiple laws of motion). In the absence of dynamic ambiguity, likelihood-based learning resolves static ambiguity. In the presence of dynamic ambiguity, on the other hand, likelihood-based learning fails. In this case, static ambiguity fades away if the agent incorporates into the objective criteria (likelihood) her subjective criteria (penalty proportional to the Kullback–Leibler divergence). The model of learning is also applied to portfolio choice.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在非可交换环境（时变瞬时预期增长率）中，影响长期增长率的模糊性是否会消退。考虑了两种类型的模糊性：静态（多重先验）和动态（多重运动定律）。在没有动态模糊性的情况下，基于似然的学习解决了静态模糊性。另一方面，在存在动态模糊性的情况下，基于似然的学习失败。在这种情况下，如果代理人将主观标准（与Kullback–Leibler散度成比例的惩罚）纳入客观标准（似然），静态模糊性就会消退。学习模型也应用于投资组合选择。

articles.title_en: On the relationship between damage and deception
articles.title_cn: 论损害与欺骗之间的关系
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a family of definitions of deceptive behavior. The definitions provide different ways to describe the notion that deceptive behavior misleads a player by inducing inaccurate beliefs. For each definition of deception, I identify a class of preferences under which behavior is deceptive if and only if it harms any player with preferences in the class. Journal of Economic Literature Classification Numbers: D02; C90; C72. Keywords: communication, damage, deception.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一组关于欺骗行为的定义。这些定义提供了不同的方式来描述欺骗行为通过诱导不准确的信念而误导参与者的概念。对于每个欺骗的定义，我确定了一类偏好，在此类偏好下，行为是欺骗性的当且仅当它对具有该类偏好的任何参与者造成损害。《经济文献杂志》分类号：D02；C90；C72。关键词：沟通，损害，欺骗。

articles.abstract_en: A defining feature of culture is similarity in the manner in which information is interpreted. This facilitates extraction of information from the beliefs of those in one’s own group, a force for homophily. However, observation of individuals outside one’s group deepens our understanding of their culture, counteracting this effect. We model this process, using unobservable, heterogeneous priors (correlated within but not across groups) to represent initial beliefs, and characterize long-run communication patterns. At moderate levels of correlation in priors, individuals can be partitioned into two categories: some exhibit extreme informational homophily, while others seek information wherever it is most precise.
articles.abstract_cn: 文化的一个显著特征是在信息解读方式上的相似性。这有助于从本群体成员的信念中提取信息，从而促进同质性。然而，观察本群体之外的个体能加深我们对其文化的理解，从而抵消这一效应。我们对此过程进行建模，使用不可观测的、异质的先验（组内相关但组间不相关）来表示初始信念，并刻画长期沟通模式。在先验相关性处于中等水平时，个体可分为两类：一类表现出极度的信息同质性，而另一类则在信息最精确之处寻求信息。

articles.abstract_en: I provide the first axiomatic characterization of Elimination by Aspects (EBA), a well-known model of stochastic choice originally proposed by Amos Tversky in 1972. The characterization is based solely on observable choice behavior and does not assume that the underlying aspects are directly observable—treating them instead as subjective. I also discuss connections between EBA and related models of stochastic choice.
articles.abstract_cn: 我提供了方面消除（EBA）模型的第一个公理化特征化，该模型是由Amos Tversky在1972年最初提出的一个著名的随机选择模型。该特征化仅基于可观察的选择行为，并不假设潜在方面是直接可观察的——而是将其视为主观的。我还讨论了EBA与相关随机选择模型之间的联系。

articles.title_en: Investment subsidies with spillovers and endogenous private information: Why Pigou got it all right
articles.title_cn: 具有溢出效应和内生私人信息的投资补贴：为什么庇古完全正确
articles.abstract_en: How should firms be incentivized to invest efficiently (e.g., in AI or the supply of smart inputs) when such investments come with spillovers and their profitability depends on uncertain aggregate economic conditions? We show that firms can be encouraged to collect information and then use it in society’s best interest through a subsidy that resembles a Pigouvian correction but accounts for the non-verifiability of firms’ acquisition and usage of information.
articles.abstract_cn: 当企业投资（例如，在人工智能或智能投入品供应方面）伴随溢出效应，且其盈利能力取决于不确定的总体经济状况时，应如何激励企业进行有效投资？我们表明，通过一种类似于庇古修正但考虑到企业信息获取和使用的不可验证性的补贴，可以鼓励企业收集信息，并按照社会最佳利益使用这些信息。

articles.title_en: Limit-of-All-Finite equilibria in infinite normal-form games
articles.title_cn: 无限正规型博弈中的有限极限均衡
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces and examines limit-of-all-finite (LOAF) equilibria, defined as strategy profiles obtained as limits of ε-equilibria along all discretizations of an infinite game. We establish conditions under which any limit of ε-equilibria along one discretization is a LOAF equilibrium, and we show that these conditions are satisfied in many common infinite games, such as Bertrand competition, wars of attrition, and standard auctions. We also identify conditions that ensure that the sets of LOAF and Nash equilibria coincide, and we discuss how our findings relate to known results on limit-of-finite perfect equilibria, approximate equilibria, and solutions for sharing rules.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文引入并考察了有限极限（LOAF）均衡，定义为沿着无限博弈的所有离散化获得的ε-均衡的极限策略组合。我们建立了条件，在这些条件下，沿着一个离散化的ε-均衡的任何极限都是LOAF均衡，并表明这些条件在许多常见的无限博弈中成立，如伯特兰竞争、消耗战和标准拍卖。我们还确定了确保LOAF均衡集与纳什均衡集一致的条件，并讨论了我们的发现与已知的有限极限完美均衡、近似均衡和共享规则解的结果之间的关系。
